title: Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline for Tabular Data (MOSTLY AI Challenge)
summary: A pipeline that trains an ensemble of CTGAN and TVAE tabular generative models with privacy filtering (DCR/NNDR) and ML utility evaluation, built for a MOSTLY AI synthetic data competition. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate the synthetic tabular data, and uses SDMetrics for quality and diagnostic reporting.
